name: Blisterbalm
body:
Blisterbalm

School conjuration (healing); Level adept 0, alchemist 1, druid 0, hunter 0, shaman 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (butter)

EFFECT

Range touch
Effect 1 dose of ointment
Duration 1 hour
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

Infusing the butter with a little positive energy, you produce a lotion that soothes skin turned red and raw by sun, wind and cold. By applying the blisterbalm ointment, a creature can reduce nonlethal damage caused by sunburn, windburn or frostburn (such as a failed Fortitude save against hot and sunny conditions) by 1 for the next hour.
